newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-OTAGO END SUPER 12 SEASON WITH A WIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-OTAGO END SUPER 12 SEASON WITH A WIN.

text.p: Bottom-placed Otago Highlanders finished their Super 12 rugby season on a defiant note with a 34-18 victory over the Waikato Chiefs on Friday.

It was only the Highlanders' third win in 11 matches this season, but they signed off in impressive style with Auckland teenager Douglas Howlett, drafted into their squad, scoring a hat-trick-of tries.
The scores were tied at 6-6 until four minutes before half-time when centre Romi Ropati smashed through the midfield defence and flicked the ball on for Howlett to finish.

Chiefs right wing Caleb Ralph brought his side back into the match shortly before the break, following a 50 metre run from left wing Eric Rush, but it didn't take Otago long to respond after the restart.
Culhane and captain Taine Randell combined well to put Howlett in for his second try and two further penalties to Culhane and one to his replacement Tony Brown took Otago well clear at 29-11.
Nine minutes from time Howlett raced 60 metres for his final try, although Glenn Taylor scored a consolation late pushover for Waikato who finish the season just one place off the bottom.

Waikato Chiefs: 15-Bruce Reihana; 14-Eric Rush, 13-Pita Alatini, 12-Scott McLeod, 11-Caleb Ralph; 10-Ian Foster, 9-Rhys Duggan; 8-Deon Muir, 7-Brett Sinkinson, 6-Aaron Hopa, 5-Glenn Taylor, 4-Ian Jones (captain), 3-Richard Loe, 2-Greg Smith, 1-Michael Collins.

Otago Highlanders: 15-Matthew Carrington; 14-Brendan Laney, 13-Romi Ropati, 12-John Leslie, 11-Doug Howlett; 10-Simon Culhane, 9-Stu Forster; 8-Taine Randell (captain), 7-Josh Kronfeld, 6-Kupu Vanisi, 5-John Blaikie, 4-Lio Falaniko, 3-Carl Hoeft, 2-Anton Oliver, 1-Kees Meeuws.
